message: docs: record verified review progress and preserve current boundary work

edits: **Status: BW16 family-tree authoring is delivered (2026-10-03); BW17's read-only first slice was delivered on 2026-09-28. Remaining promise controls and feeling processes need their own authorization.** Current [social rules](../worlds/base/social.md) and [gameplay availability](../../archive/05-project/implementation-status.md#gameplay-availability) distinguish existing support from these new surfaces. Family authoring is complete. BW17’s existing boundary and read-preparation corrections do not wait for another product decision; amendment/cancellation controls still depend on the remaining policy choice. Consider [ACT09](actor-model.md#act09--internal-feeling-process-authoring) only when an authored scenario needs it. No requirement to expose every native primitive as a UI.

The October 4 promise continuation reviewed source at `0043672ff9ba658515384a5593f3d003fb1d2a8c`, with main still at the pinned revision above. It corrects [the social delivery summary](../worlds/base/social.md#delivery-and-evidence) to reflect the delivered family editor and read-only promise list. [BW17](../maintainers/base-world.md#bw17--readable-promises-and-commitment-management) now explicitly retains the current English/gathering/tuning/help boundary defect rather than postponing it until new promise language is added. The [paired promise design](readable-promises-tech-design.md#5-performance-and-bounds) distinguishes bounded database pages from repeated resident-memory scans and an unpaged partial-history fallback, preserving distinct admission-count and visible-open meanings. Its dated project tables remain **In progress**; a single-account fixture does not establish cross-account denial. The camp and interface project records also distinguish delivered mechanisms from open storage, policy and qualification work, and the mercenary art record now acknowledges its presence in the pinned main without claiming final style or production acceptance. This is source/document reconciliation only, with no new gameplay, database or provider execution.

Validation for this continuation: all nine changed Markdown files passed pinned formatting and affected-diff review; seven newly added local links/anchors were checked. The publishing workflow passed its exact-content checks, guidance check and whitespace check. Full CI on staging commit `4d501480` passed guidance and generated configuration, then stopped on formatting in 64 repertoire files untouched by this continuation; later type, test and build stages did not run. That remains a branch-wide gate, not a failure of the nine changed files and not permission for unrelated formatting churn. Of the 25 project descriptions found without status tables at `0043672`, four now have reconciled tables; 21 still need status review/filing. These counts describe that specific structural check, not exhaustive semantic coverage.
